Problem Statement
Read a 3-digit integer and print its digits in reverse order, using the % and / operators to pull out each digit.
Description
Read a 3-digit integer num. Extract its last digit using the % operator, then remove that digit using the / operator, and repeat this to extract the middle and first digits. Combine the three extracted digits in reverse order to form the reversed number, and print it. No loop is needed since the number always has exactly three digits.
Input Description
A single line containing a 3-digit integer num (100 ≤ num ≤ 999).
Output Description
Print the reverse of num.
Sample Input
123
Sample Output
321
